name: LouLou & Luxe — Decoupled Headless Backend API (WAF + Git Error Tracer + Self-Learning AI Search)

parameters.content:
## 🛡️ LouLou & Luxe — Decoupled Headless Backend API (`Personal > POD > LouLou & Luxe`)
- **`POST /webhook/loulou-api-search`**: Anti-Bog WAF + Learned Synonym & Conversion Affinity Ranking (`loulou_product_query_affinity`).
- **`POST /webhook/loulou-api-feedback`**: Online Reinforcement Learning from clicks, wishlist saves, cart adds, purchases & explicit 👍/👎 (`loulou_llm_feedback_memory`).
- **`POST /webhook/loulou-api-error-trace`**: Git-Traceable Error Engine (`loulou_git_error_traces`) returning exact GitHub `blob/development/<file>#L<line>` blame links.

nodes.name: 1C. Postgres: Query Learned Product Affinity Boosts

parameters.query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS loulou_product_query_affinity (
  normalized_query VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL,
  product_sku VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
  search_impressions INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  click_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  wishlist_adds INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  cart_adds INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  purchases INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  explicit_thumbs_up INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  explicit_thumbs_down INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  learned_boost_score NUMERIC(10, 4) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0000,
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  PRIMARY KEY (normalized_query, product_sku)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS loulou_learned_query_synonyms (
  raw_search_term VARCHAR(160) PRIMARY KEY,
  expanded_keywords TEXT[] NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  confidence_score NUMERIC(5, 4) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.8500,
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

SELECT
  TRUE AS ok,
  'HEADLESS_SEARCH_RANKED' AS status,
  '{{ $json.safeQuery }}' AS query,
  {{ $json.blocked }} AS waf_blocked,
  COALESCE(
    (SELECT json_object_agg(product_sku, learned_boost_score)
     FROM loulou_product_query_affinity
     WHERE normalized_query = '{{ $json.safeQuery }}'),
    '{}'::json
  ) AS "boostMap",
  'https://github.com/banerjee08/print_on_demand/blob/development/apps/backend/src/modules/search/adaptive-llm-search.ts#L112' AS "gitSourceUrl";

nodes.name: 1D. Return Ranked Search & Git Trace Metadata
2C. Postgres: Update Product Affinity & Few-Shot LLM Memory

parameters.query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS loulou_product_query_affinity (
  normalized_query VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL,
  product_sku VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
  search_impressions INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  click_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  wishlist_adds INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  cart_adds INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  purchases INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  explicit_thumbs_up INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  explicit_thumbs_down INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  learned_boost_score NUMERIC(10, 4) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0000,
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  PRIMARY KEY (normalized_query, product_sku)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS loulou_llm_feedback_memory (
  feedback_id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  feature_domain VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
  user_input_prompt TEXT NOT NULL,
  recommended_sku VARCHAR(64),
  signal_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
  reward_score NUMERIC(6, 2) NOT NULL,
  user_feedback_notes TEXT,
  promoted_to_few_shot BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

INSERT INTO loulou_product_query_affinity (
  normalized_query, product_sku, search_impressions, click_count, wishlist_adds, cart_adds, purchases,
  explicit_thumbs_up, explicit_thumbs_down, learned_boost_score, updated_at
)
VALUES (
  '{{ $json.safeQuery }}',
  '{{ $json.productSku }}',
  1,
  {{ $json.isClick }},
  {{ $json.isWish }},
  {{ $json.isCart }},
  {{ $json.isBuy }},
  {{ $json.isUp }},
  {{ $json.isDown }},
  {{ $json.delta }},
  NOW()
)
ON CONFLICT (normalized_query, product_sku) DO UPDATE SET
  search_impressions = loulou_product_query_affinity.search_impressions + 1,
  click_count = loulou_product_query_affinity.click_count + {{ $json.isClick }},
  wishlist_adds = loulou_product_query_affinity.wishlist_adds + {{ $json.isWish }},
  cart_adds = loulou_product_query_affinity.cart_adds + {{ $json.isCart }},
  purchases = loulou_product_query_affinity.purchases + {{ $json.isBuy }},
  explicit_thumbs_up = loulou_product_query_affinity.explicit_thumbs_up + {{ $json.isUp }},
  explicit_thumbs_down = loulou_product_query_affinity.explicit_thumbs_down + {{ $json.isDown }},
  learned_boost_score = LEAST(50.0, GREATEST(-20.0, loulou_product_query_affinity.learned_boost_score + ({{ $json.delta }}))),
  updated_at = NOW();

INSERT INTO loulou_llm_feedback_memory (
  feature_domain, user_input_prompt, recommended_sku, signal_type, reward_score, user_feedback_notes, promoted_to_few_shot
)
VALUES (
  'SEARCH_RANKING',
  '{{ $json.safeQuery }}',
  '{{ $json.productSku }}',
  '{{ $json.signalType }}',
  {{ $json.delta }},
  '{{ $json.notes }}',
  ({{ $json.delta }} >= 3.0)
);

SELECT
  TRUE AS ok,
  'RL_FEEDBACK_LEARNED' AS status,
  '{{ $json.safeQuery }}' AS query,
  '{{ $json.productSku }}' AS "productSku",
  '{{ $json.signalType }}' AS "signalType",
  (SELECT learned_boost_score FROM loulou_product_query_affinity WHERE normalized_query = '{{ $json.safeQuery }}' AND product_sku = '{{ $json.productSku }}' LIMIT 1) AS "updatedLearnedBoostScore",
  'https://github.com/banerjee08/print_on_demand/blob/development/apps/backend/src/modules/search/adaptive-llm-search.ts#L194' AS "gitSourceUrl";

nodes.name: 3B. Construct GitHub #L<line> Blame URL & CLI Fix Command
3C. Postgres: Persist Git Error Trace & Occurrence Count

parameters.query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS loulou_git_error_traces (
  trace_id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  error_code VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
  service_module VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
  git_repo VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'banerjee08/print_on_demand',
  git_branch VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'development',
  file_path VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL,
  line_number INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  github_blame_url TEXT NOT NULL,
  git_cli_fix_command TEXT NOT NULL,
  error_message TEXT NOT NULL,
  occurrence_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  last_seen_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  UNIQUE (error_code, file_path, line_number)
);

INSERT INTO loulou_git_error_traces (
  error_code, service_module, git_repo, git_branch, file_path, line_number,
  github_blame_url, git_cli_fix_command, error_message, occurrence_count, last_seen_at
)
VALUES (
  '{{ $json.errorCode }}',
  '{{ $json.serviceModule }}',
  '{{ $json.gitRepo }}',
  '{{ $json.gitBranch }}',
  '{{ $json.filePath }}',
  {{ $json.lineNumber }},
  '{{ $json.githubBlameUrl }}',
  '{{ $json.gitCliFixCommand }}',
  '{{ $json.message }}',
  1,
  NOW()
)
ON CONFLICT (error_code, file_path, line_number) DO UPDATE SET
  occurrence_count = loulou_git_error_traces.occurrence_count + 1,
  error_message = EXCLUDED.error_message,
  last_seen_at = NOW();

SELECT
  TRUE AS ok,
  'GIT_ERROR_TRACE_LOGGED' AS status,
  '{{ $json.errorCode }}' AS "errorCode",
  '{{ $json.filePath }}' AS "filePath",
  {{ $json.lineNumber }} AS "lineNumber",
  '{{ $json.githubBlameUrl }}' AS "githubBlameUrl",
  '{{ $json.gitCliFixCommand }}' AS "gitCliFixCommand",
  (SELECT occurrence_count FROM loulou_git_error_traces WHERE error_code = '{{ $json.errorCode }}' AND file_path = '{{ $json.filePath }}' AND line_number = {{ $json.lineNumber }} LIMIT 1) AS "occurrenceCount";
